digest.component_or_area: ticket creation and editing with plan-review gate integration
propositions: When a ticket is created or edited with a description exceeding the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be displayed at save time to alert the user before the claim gate rejects it at review time.
The warning must be emitted via the appropriate channel for each surface: stderr for CLI, rebar logger for library calls, and result field for MCP, while the save operation always succeeds unchanged.

The save-time warning and the plan-review gate admission guard must both read from the same config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars) to ensure a consistent, single-sourced cap across all paths.
No warning is emitted when the gate is disabled, the description is within the cap, or the ticket type is exempt from the gate.
